title: In Person
resolution_html:
Requirements to use this method:

  1. You must have your YU-card (preferred). If not, then government-issued photo ID, such as a driver's license, passport, etc
  2. Your employee number. **Please note that it is normally on your YU-card, but otherwise it is also on your pay stub
  3. Be able to come to a UIT Service Desk Counter during our business hours. See our hours of operation>>

If you have met this method's requirements:

  1. Come to a UIT Service Desk Counter. We are located on the 1st floor of the Steacie Science Library building - see map for location. We also have another service desk inside Scott Library - see map for location
  2. The staff on duty will only be able to reset your Passport York password if appropriate photo ID is presented
